name: Isidora Herrera
bio:
Isidora's fascination with motorsport began as a child, watching Formula 1 races with her grandfather. This early exposure ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in Aeronautical Engineering at the University of Chile. After graduating, she quickly found a place at a local racing team, where she honed her skills in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. Her dedication and innovative approach soon caught the attention of Akkodis ASP Team, who headhunted her for the position of Head of Aero.

At Akkodis ASP Team, Isidora leads a team of engineers focused on optimizing the aerodynamic performance of the team's vehicles. She is known for her meticulous approach and her ability to translate complex data into practical solutions. Isidora believes in fostering a collaborative environment where team members are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of aerodynamic design. Her blend of technical expertise and commitment to innovation makes her a valuable asset to the team.

Isidora stands out due to her unique ability to blend cutting-edge computational fluid dynamics simulations with real-world track testing. She is known to be a very hands-on leader and can often be found personally analyzing telemetry data alongside her team, ensuring the theoretical models align perfectly with the actual vehicle performance.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail, with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Isidora has a slender build and a focused, intense gaze that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Chilean coffee in the office.
